component.name: Telegram Drive
component.summary: Use your Telegram account as cloud storage for your files

description.p: This is a community package of Telegram Drive, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified. The source is public, but the project has not published a license yet.

Telegram Drive organizes the files you keep in Saved Messages and Telegram channels as a drive on your desktop. You sign in with your own Telegram account and API credentials; files go straight to Telegram, with no separate relay server.

ul.li: Folders backed by Telegram channels, with list and grid views, search, sorting and bulk actions.
Durable upload and download queues with pause, resume, retry and bandwidth limits.
Previews for images and PDFs, and playback for audio and video.
Folder Sync, a loopback-only WebDAV server and a local REST API.

description.p: Every feature is free. The app shows sponsor placements, which an optional one-time supporter license from the developer removes.

The package has network access and no filesystem grant: settings, the local database and caches stay in the application's private per-app directory, the Telegram session is kept in the system keyring, and uploads and downloads go through the file chooser. Folder Sync watches a whole directory, which the file chooser cannot grant; to sync a folder, grant it first, for example flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-documents com.cameronamer.telegramdrive, and undo it with flatpak override --user --reset com.cameronamer.telegramdrive.

HEIC previews and video thumbnails use an FFmpeg installed on the host, which the sandbox cannot run; those files are shown without a preview. Updates come through Flatpak; if the application offers to install an update itself, update with Flatpak instead.
